name: Nellie Frances Hampton (Smith, Hermann)

Born 4 Jul 1860 at Albany, Linn County, Oregon; married Thomas Smith on 24 Dec 1877 in Linn County, and Charles Alexander Hermann (1853–1924) in 1896; died 18 Jan 1947 in Portland, aged 86, and was buried at Rose City Cemetery.
